legend: After winning a hard-fought battle against Ogre Magi, Thrall returned to his manufactory in upland Druud to repair his stormcrafting device. He was tinkering around with the plates of a faulty circular parallel plate capacitor that he retrieved from the heart of the device. Both of the circular plates have a uniform radius of r$$$r$$$ units. Thrall wanted to control the distance d$$$d$$$ between the two plates, and so he decided to join them by soldering many equally spaced strings of length L$$$L$$$. One end of each string was soldered to the side of the +ve$$$+ve$$$ plate, while the other end was soldered to the side of the −ve$$$-ve$$$ plate.
Figure 1: Salvaging the spoils of war.
This contraption enabled him to rotate one of the circular plates (say, the +ve$$$+ve$$$ plate) and consequently calibrate the value of d$$$d$$$.
Figure 2: Rotating the +ve$$$+ve$$$ plate by different angles (θ$$$\theta$$$).
If Thrall rotates the +ve$$$+ve$$$ circular plate by an angle of θ$$$\theta$$$ degrees, what would be the corresponding value of d$$$d$$$, the distance between the circular plates?
input: The first line contains an integer t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤100)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 100)$$$ — the number of test cases.

Each test case consists of a single line containing three space-separated integers r$$$r$$$ (0<r≤109)$$$(0  \lt  r \leq 10^9)$$$, L$$$L$$$ (0<L≤109)$$$(0  \lt  L \leq 10^9)$$$, and θ$$$\theta$$$ (0∘<θ∘<180∘)$$$(0^{\circ}  \lt  \theta^{\circ}  \lt  180^{\circ})$$$ — the radius of the plates, the length of the strings, and the angle (in degrees) by which Thrall rotates the +ve$$$+ve$$$ plate respectively.

It is guaranteed that for all test cases, the string length L$$$L$$$ is sufficient to allow the rotation of the +ve$$$+ve$$$ plate by θ$$$\theta$$$ degrees, resulting in a real and non-negative value of d$$$d$$$.
output: For each test case, output a single number d$$$d$$$ in a line — the distance between the circular plates.
The answer will be considered correct if the absolute error does not exceed 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$.

legend.ai: 在与 Ogre Magi 进行了一场艰苦的战斗并获胜后，Thrall 回到了位于 Druud 高地的制造厂，修理他的风暴制造装置。他从装置内部取出了一只发生故障的圆形平行板电容器，并摆弄起它的极板。两块圆形极板的半径均为 r$$$r$$$ 个单位。Thrall 想要控制两块极板之间的距离 d$$$d$$$，于是决定焊接许多长度为 L$$$L$$$ 且等间距分布的绳子将它们连接起来。每根绳子的一端焊接在 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 极板的侧面，另一端则焊接在 −ve$$$-ve$$$ 极板的侧面。
这个装置使他能够旋转其中一块圆形板(比如 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 板)，从而校准 d$$$d$$$ 的值。
图 2：将 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 板旋转不同的角度(θ$$$\theta$$$)。
如果 Thrall 将 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 圆盘旋转 θ$$$\theta$$$ 度，那么圆盘之间的距离 d$$$d$$$ 对应的值是多少？

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤100)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 100)$$$——表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例由一行组成，包含三个空格分隔的整数 r$$$r$$$ (0<r≤109)$$$(0  \lt  r \leq 10^9)$$$、L$$$L$$$ (0<L≤109)$$$(0  \lt  L \leq 10^9)$$$ 和 θ$$$\theta$$$ (0∘<θ∘<180∘)$$$(0^{\circ}  \lt  \theta^{\circ}  \lt  180^{\circ})$$$——分别表示圆盘的半径、绳子的长度，以及 Thrall 将 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 圆盘旋转的角度(单位：度)。
保证对于所有测试用例，绳子长度 L$$$L$$$ 足以支持 +ve$$$+ve$$$ 圆盘旋转 θ$$$\theta$$$ 度，从而使 d$$$d$$$ 得到实数且非负的值。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，在一行中输出一个数字 d$$$d$$$——即圆盘之间的距离。
如果绝对误差不超过 10−6$$$10^{-6}$$$，则答案将被视为正确。
